theme: An open day to land travel logistics before the girls arrive tomorrow.
greeting: You're back on the ground in St Pete, Dan, with a clear calendar — a good runway to lock down tonight's room and the car before Tuesday's pickup.

needsAttention.title: Erika at Brunswick is waiting to talk
needsAttention.detail: Lauren Nadig connected you with Erika Maass, who leads senior recruitment at Brunswick and already has your resume; it's on you two to find a time, and the intro's been sitting since Thursday while you were sailing.

needsAttention.title: Nowhere booked for tonight in St Pete
needsAttention.detail: You landed TPA yesterday and the Sept 20–22 landing gap still shows no lodging booked — tonight's the second of those two nights before Tuesday's 3 PM kid pickup.

needsAttention.title: The Sept 20–Oct 5 SUV isn't booked
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of TPA needs to be in hand before you drive to the Orlando villa Tuesday; walking up jet-lagged with four kids and no car is the thing to avoid.

needsAttention.title: Passport appointment still needs rescheduling
needsAttention.detail: The four-kid passport appointment was set to be rebooked after your Sept 20 return; it's flagged p1 and due today, and the signed packet and payments need to be ready before whatever date you land on.

flagged.title: Placement-agent intros in motion
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano at Valoris says he'll ask fund-manager contacts to recommend a placement agent for you; you're cc'd and nothing's owed yet.

flagged.title: Venmo request — $50 for mowing
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requested $50 for the 9/17 mow.

flagged.title: David Brooks talk shared from Maine
flagged.detail: A friend forwarded a David Brooks talk from Yale — a read-when-you-have-a-moment, not a to-do.

inbox.noise: About a dozen newsletters and trip-review nudges — Responsible Investor, FT, the Italian word of the day, Kayak, LinkedIn.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply this morning.

resolved.title: Home from the Croatia sailing course
resolved.detail: You landed TPA yesterday; the Dubrovnik charter and all the Cavtat logistics are behind you.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: The first real week of autumn calls for something slow-roasted and golden — pumpkins and winter squash are hitting the markets now.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the clear stretch to book tonight's room and the Sept 20–Oct 5 SUV before rates climb.
Still open; a natural window to sort Disney tickets and set the passport reschedule.
Your last quiet night before Tuesday's 3 PM pickup and the Orlando stretch — bank the rest.
